note: Zimbabwe, read on the Department of Immigration's Permits and Fees pages (zimimmigration.gov.zw) and in the Immigration Act (Chapter 4:02) as it serves it, on 2026-10-30; fees are set in US dollars, so the file's currency is USD. A temporary employment permit (the Act provides for it by regulation, s. 19) is asked on the residence permit form I.F.5 and the temporary employment form, with the contract of employment, the post's local newspaper advertisement and the understudies' details (work for the sponsor); its statutory non-refundable fee is US$500 (US$300 per dependant), and an extension costs US$500 (renewable). Where it is lodged isn't stated ('either'). A non-investor's permanent residence permit costs US$500 (an investor's US$1,000); it is read as applied for in Zimbabwe, and the years it asks aren't on the pages (the Act's domicile, ten years' lawful ordinary residence, excludes years on any permit other than a residence permit, so a temporary employment permit's years aren't read as leading to it). Terms and decision times aren't stated; naturalisation (the Citizenship of Zimbabwe Act) isn't written.

sources.title: Immigration Act [Chapter 4:02]
sources.said: “temporary employment permit” means a temporary employment permit issued in terms of this Act; ... ordinarily resided therein for a continuous period of ten years, which period shall not include— ... resided in Zimbabwe in terms of any permit other than a residence permit;
